title: Hide Galacticraft Equipments
body:
This pack hides Galacticraft equipments, which might be annoying when you are using custom player models or custom armors from Extra Bit Manipulation.

This pack hides:

- oxygen mask
- oxygen gear
- oxygen tanks
- frequency module
- thermal paddings

This pack doesn't hide:

parachutes, which doesn't show up unless landing on earth
